in_marathi.name: Chyavan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chyavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chyavan is the name of a great sage in Hindu mythology. He is renowned for his immense knowledge, self-discipline, and long life. The name Chyavan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chyavanaprashtha', which translates to 'one who has taken refuge in asceticism'. The sage Chyavan is also known for his unique method of preparing a rejuvenating drink called 'Chyavanprash', which is widely consumed even today for its health benefits.
